instruction: The method name `get_headers` on `HTTPException` (src/werkzeug/exceptions.py) does not say which headers it returns. Rename `HTTPException.get_headers` to `response_headers`. The rename must cover the base class, every subclass that overrides it, and every place that calls or refers to it, including tests. Leave comments, docstrings and other documentation text unchanged. Behavior must not change: the project must still work and its tests must pass.
